name: Virtual PCIe AI card (sim)
summary: Hostless stand-in for the PCIe endpoint CPU+AI card (architecture/uncore/pcie-endpoint.md + ai-matrix). No PCB, no kernel, no real PCIe: soft-sticky UIO + eventfd userspace path for CI (ai-tensor/tools/virt_ai_card). Models virtio-net/SSH workload push and BAR4 bulk tensor transfer over localhost TCP.

controllers.note: Planned PCIe endpoint (verilog-pcie) — virtual board does not fetch PHY/controller; real card promotion enables this.

interfaces.notes: Simulated PCIe endpoint (BAR0 mgmt/AI CAP, BAR2 virtio, BAR4 bulk). Hostless: VirtualPcieLink TCP.
Control/data path model for SSH/Ray-style workload push (JSON over TCP in virt_ai_card).
Card-side agent stand-in for ssh/job submit (card_agent.py).
Resizable BAR4 bulk tensor window (process-local buffer or socket copy).
Soft UIO CAP/CTL window (VirtualUioDevice); primary connector island0 soft-sticky.

island0.notes: CI primary: hostless soft-sticky CAP/CTL (VirtualUioDevice). AI_TENSOR_UIO=virt://virt-ai-pcie/island0

island0_irq.notes: Virtual eventfd (threading.Event + counter). Claim DONE @0x10C before clear/rearm (PLIC-8 discipline).
